description: Use this when the user asks which Winquill workspace ChatGPT uses, or which countries' tenders it shows: returns Winquill's settings in ChatGPT, the workspace (for someone in more than one) and the workspace's countries. Needs a Winquill account. Do not use for the company profile (use save_company_profile).
name: get_tenda_settings
title: Winquill settings
